papers.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人潜在世界模型的能力如何随模型规模、数据和计算扩展，目前缺乏原则性估计方法，阻碍了该领域进展。
ai_summary.method: 提出 RoboJEPA，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型，并在覆盖12种机器人本体的大规模数据集上训练。论文分析其想象误差随计算规模的扩展规律，并评估下游机器人规划性能的可预测性。
ai_summary.result: RoboJEPA 的想象误差随计算量呈二阶幂律缩放，可外推预测模型质量；下游机器人规划性能随计算量可预测提升，且想象误差与规划性能强相关。模型还能零样本部署为机器人智能体，仅用单张目标图像在真实硬件上完成长程规划任务。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次为基于真实机器人数据训练的多本体机器人世界模型建立缩放定律，并发布了迄今最大的8B参数JEPA预测器模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人世界模型的规模化训练与评估提供了可预测的缩放规律和可靠代理指标，推动零样本机器人规划与通用机器人智能体发展。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息为空，无法从给定内容识别）

papers.title: Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）对指令措辞高度敏感，即使只改一个词也可能导致成功率大幅波动，且这种语言鲁棒性缺陷并未从底层视觉-语言模型继承。
ai_summary.method: 作者通过统计检验的单次编辑波动和oracle短语搜索来刻画这种敏感性，发现其系统性后可表达为显式规则；具体做法是用大语言模型从少量训练任务的多种措辞评分中蒸馏出10到20条改写规则，并在部署时对每条输入指令按规则重写一次，而不修改策略模型。
ai_summary.result: 该方法无需重新训练或逐步验证，在12个留出任务上对冻结的π0模型相对提升16%到27%，增益集中在分布外任务；在π0.5和LIBERO上可复现，将微调内成功率从93.6%提升至97.8%。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出一种训练无关的指令改写框架，通过LLM蒸馏显式改写规则来系统性地缓解VLA的指令措辞敏感性问题。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了VLA语言鲁棒性的关键短板，并提供即插即用的部署侧解决方案，对具身智能和机器人指令泛化有直接意义。
ai_summary.org: Independent Researcher 和 University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)

papers.title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching
papers.abstract: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.

ai_summary.problem: 如何高效地对流策略（flow policies）进行离策略强化学习微调，以超越演示数据，同时避免对每步流过程计算昂贵的向量-雅可比积。
ai_summary.method: 作者发现预训练流策略的批次平均速度雅可比集中在对角线上，据此推导出闭式标量伴随（scalar adjoint）：仅用流时间缩放最终动作处的价值梯度，从而消除逐步向量-雅可比积；并提出SQAM，结合标量伴随与对策略生成动作处的价值惩罚。
ai_summary.result: SQAM在OGBench四个最难领域中将成功率相比最强基线提升18到35个百分点，并在真实双臂机器人上微调视觉-语言-动作策略，三个任务均优于监督微调。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出闭式标量伴随匹配，将流策略RL中的伴随匹配简化为标量缩放，并结合价值惩罚稳定critic，显著降低计算成本。
ai_summary.relevance: 为流策略和大型VLA模型的强化学习微调提供了高效、可扩展的方法，对具身智能和机器人学习具有重要意义。
ai_summary.org: 未提供

papers.title: MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency
papers.abstract: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.

ai_summary.problem: 现有低空无人机多模态感知缺乏真实世界、逐帧标注且跨RGB、热成像、LiDAR和雷达语义一致的公开数据集，而逐模态人工标注成本高且一致性差。
ai_summary.method: 构建MultiFly真实低空无人机多模态数据集，提供同步的RGB、热成像、LiDAR和雷达样本；仅用115张人工标注RGB图像，通过共享几何表示将标签传播到其余RGB、热成像、LiDAR和雷达数据；并建立四种模态的语义分割基准。
ai_summary.result: 数据集包含17,272个同步样本、15类逐帧标注，并生成大量额外模态标签；标签迁移与人工标注平均一致率达89.93%，六组模态对平均语义一致性达90.94%，同时揭示了密集LiDAR与稀疏雷达在分割架构上的不同行为。
ai_summary.novelty: 据称是首个公开的真实世界低空航空基准，为RGB、热成像、LiDAR和雷达提供一致的逐帧语义标注，并提出高效的跨模态标签迁移方案。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态航空感知、跨模态语义一致性和标注高效学习提供了可扩展的数据基础与评测基准。

papers.title: Open-MMUnlearning: Unifying Methods and Evaluation for MLLM Unlearning
papers.abstract: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become more capable and widely deployed, concerns about privacy and safety have become increasingly pressing. Machine unlearning offers one approach to addressing these concerns by removing designated information from trained models while preserving unrelated capabilities. However, fragmented implementations and evaluation protocols, incomplete robustness testing, and limited understanding of metric reliability make progress in MLLM unlearning difficult to assess systematically. We introduce Open-MMUnlearning, an open-source, extensible framework that integrates target-model preparation, multimodal data processing, unlearning, and evaluation through shared interfaces and structured configurations. The framework supports five benchmarks spanning privacy, safety, and copyright, eight MLLMs from four model families, and twelve unlearning methods. Its evaluation suite jointly assesses forgetting effectiveness, retained utility, and robustness to model interventions, adversarial inputs, and membership inference attacks. Using a common evaluation protocol, we compare ten representative unlearning methods. In this comparison, GD and MIP-Editor tie for the highest overall score: GD achieves the highest Forget Quality, while MIP-Editor preserves more Model Utility. We further introduce a metric meta-evaluation protocol that tests faithfulness using models with controlled exposure to target knowledge and robustness under quantization and relearning. Among the thirteen evaluated metrics, BLEU achieves the highest aggregate reliability score. KS-Test attains the highest faithfulness AUC but performs less well on robustness. Together, the framework and these findings support reproducible comparison of MLLM unlearning methods and systematic assessment of evaluation reliability.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型（MLLM）机器遗忘研究存在实现与评估协议碎片化、鲁棒性测试不完整、评价指标可靠性理解不足的问题，导致进展难以系统评估。
ai_summary.method: 提出开源可扩展框架 Open-MMUnlearning，统一目标模型准备、多模态数据处理、遗忘与评估接口，覆盖5个基准、8个MLLM和12种遗忘方法，并联合评估遗忘效果、保留效用及对模型干预、对抗输入和成员推断攻击的鲁棒性；还引入指标元评估协议。
ai_summary.result: 在统一评估协议下比较10种代表性遗忘方法：GD与MIP-Editor总分并列最高，GD遗忘质量最好，MIP-Editor模型效用保持更好；在13个指标中，BLEU综合可靠性最高，KS-Test忠实度AUC最高但鲁棒性较差。
ai_summary.novelty: 将多基准、多模型、多方法的统一评估与指标可靠性元评估结合，为MLLM遗忘提供可复现比较框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的隐私与安全治理提供可复现的遗忘评测基础设施和方法选型依据。
ai_summary.org: 未提供/无法识别

papers.title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
papers.abstract: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人灵巧抓取中，如何利用高分辨率动态触觉提升抓取稳定性预测，并减少对显式接触/力建模的依赖。
ai_summary.method: 采集了200个物体、10000次抓取试验的多模态数据集，使用配备四个Digit 360触觉传感器的多指手记录视觉、本体感觉和触觉流；训练端到端时序多模态模型，从提离前观察预测提离后稳定性，并比较不同模态与编码骨干。
ai_summary.result: 引入触觉尤其是高分辨率动态触觉能提升抓取稳定性预测；将学习到的预测器作为在线稳定性门控后，视触觉模型引导的重新抓取使实际提离成功率比无触觉门控提高10.5个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统构建并公开了多指灵巧手高分辨率动态视触觉抓取数据集，并验证时序触觉模型可在不显式建模接触或力的情况下实现在线稳定性门控与重抓取。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了丰富指尖触觉与表达性时序模型结合可扩展至灵巧操作，为数据驱动的触觉机器人学习和多模态世界模型提供重要路径。
ai_summary.org: TU Dresden / LASR Lab（根据作者 Roberto Calandra 及数据集主页 lasr-lab.github.io 推测）

papers.title: Neural Sampling with Reweighted Normalizing Flows via the Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao JKO Scheme
papers.abstract: We propose a neural algorithm for sampling from distributions specified by unnormalized Boltzmann densities. Our approach is based on the Jordan--Kinderlehrer--Otto scheme for the Kullback--Leibler divergence in the Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry (WFR JKO scheme). Our contributions are twofold. First, we prove that, for any fixed step size, the exact WFR JKO iterates converge exponentially fast to the target as the number of iterations tends to infinity. Notably, this result requires no structural assumptions on the target, such as log-concavity or a logarithmic Sobolev inequality. Second, we develop a neural implementation of the WFR JKO scheme that parametrizes its transport and reaction components using reweighted normalizing flows. Numerical experiments on challenging multimodal targets demonstrate the promising performance of the proposed method.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文研究如何从不归一化的 Boltzmann 密度中进行神经采样，尤其是处理复杂多峰分布时现有方法依赖较强结构假设的问题。
ai_summary.method: 论文基于 Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao 几何下的 Kullback--Leibler 散度的 JKO 格式，证明精确 WFR JKO 迭代的指数收敛性，并用重加权归一化流参数化其中的传输与反应部分，实现神经采样算法。
ai_summary.result: 理论上，对任意固定步长，精确 WFR JKO 迭代可指数快速收敛到目标分布，且无需 log-concavity 或对数 Sobolev 不等式等结构假设；数值实验在困难多峰目标上表现良好。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将 WFR JKO 格式与重加权归一化流结合，并在无目标结构假设下证明精确迭代的指数收敛性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为能量模型、复杂分布采样和生成建模提供了新的理论与神经实现思路，对 AI 中的概率推断与采样任务有潜在价值。
ai_summary.org: 可能为柏林工业大学（TU Berlin），摘要中未明确提供作者机构信息。

papers.title: VideoEvolve: Co-Evolving Memory and Retrieval for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Long video understanding increasingly relies on external memory to organize massive visual streams into compact representations. However, most memory-based methods dynamically adapt how information is retrieved for different questions, while largely fixing what is remembered. This mismatch makes missing details costly to recover, whereas stored information is valuable only when it can be reliably retrieved. To address this issue, we propose VideoEvolve, a novel self-evolving framework that jointly evolves memory and retrieval for long video understanding. Specifically, starting from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, VideoEvolve couples a Memory Evolver for selective memory augmentation with a Retrieval Evolver for adaptive retrieval over the evolving memory. We then co-evolve the two Evolvers through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL), updating one while freezing the other. To steer this alternating evolution, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) identifies whether the current bottleneck lies in memory or retrieval and directs optimization toward the more limiting side. Furthermore, VideoEvolve introduces Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) to alleviate downstream feedback from over-specializing memory to a fixed set of training questions, shifting training toward underdeveloped yet learnable video capabilities. By integrating Agentic RL with BEF and CEF, VideoEvolve transforms downstream reasoning experience into transferable capability updates, providing a concrete path from static long-video systems toward experience-driven, self-improving multimodal intelligence. Extensive experiments on multiple long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoEvolve.

ai_summary.problem: 现有长视频理解的外部记忆方法通常只动态调整检索，而记忆内容基本固定，导致缺失细节难以恢复且存储信息未必能被可靠检索。论文旨在解决记忆与检索不匹配、二者无法协同演化的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 VideoEvolve，一个自演化框架，从低帧率概览出发，联合演化 Memory Evolver（选择性记忆增强）与 Retrieval Evolver（自适应检索）。通过交替式 Agentic RL 更新一方并冻结另一方，并用瓶颈感知演化反馈 BEF 判断瓶颈在记忆还是检索以指导优化，用能力感知演化反馈 CEF 缓解对固定训练问题的过拟合，转向可学习但未充分发展的视频能力。
ai_summary.result: 在多个长视频理解基准上的大量实验表明 VideoEvolve 有效，并能将下游推理经验转化为可迁移的能力更新；摘要未给出具体指标。
ai_summary.novelty: 将记忆与检索作为共同演化对象，并通过瓶颈感知和能力感知反馈驱动交替式 Agentic RL，实现经验驱动的自改进长视频理解。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长视频多模态理解提供了从静态记忆系统走向可自我改进、经验驱动的多模态智能的路径，对世界模型、Agent 和多模态大模型具有启发意义。

papers.title: Detecting Adversarial Images through Response Profiles of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Adversarial perturbations can alter the predictions of frozen vision-language models (VLMs) while leaving their confidence and image--text similarity patterns seemingly plausible. We investigate whether we can identify adversarial inputs based on the broader way an image interacts with a collection of general semantic prompts. Our detector summarizes these responses using category-level statistics, relationships among prompts, deviations from clean reference distributions, and stability under weak image transformations, producing a compact response profile that is classified by a lightweight model while the VLM remains fixed. We evaluate the approach on multiple public image datasets, several CLIP-style visual backbones, and a range of gradient-based, optimization-based, automated, and spatial attacks. The detector achieves strong discrimination in attack-specific settings and retains substantial performance when evaluated on attacks not seen during training. Under a controlled detector-specific protocol, the response-profile representation outperforms the evaluated embedding-geometry baselines. Additional analyses show that the feature groups provide complementary information and that the method remains effective under variations in the prompt configuration. We also examine inference cost and performance against detector-aware adaptive attacks. Overall, the results indicate that response patterns across semantic prompts provide a useful complementary signal for adversarial image detection in frozen VLMs.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文研究如何检测针对冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）的对抗图像，尤其是那些能改变预测但使置信度和图文相似度看似合理的对抗扰动。
ai_summary.method: 方法让图像与一组通用语义提示交互，提取类别级统计、提示间关系、与干净参考分布的偏差以及弱图像变换下的稳定性，形成紧凑的响应画像，并用轻量分类器在VLM固定不变的情况下进行判别。
ai_summary.result: 在多个公开图像数据集、多种CLIP风格视觉骨干和多种攻击下，检测器在特定攻击设置中表现强，对训练未见攻击也保持较好性能，并在受控协议下优于嵌入几何基线；特征组互补且对提示配置变化较稳健。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出利用冻结VLM在大量语义提示上的广泛响应模式作为对抗图像检测的补充信号，而非仅依赖置信度或图文相似度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为冻结视觉语言模型提供了一种实用的对抗检测思路，并强调语义提示响应画像对可信多模态模型的价值。

papers.title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
papers.abstract: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

ai_summary.problem: 通用智能体在数字任务上表现优异，但其能力能否迁移到物理世界中的机器人操作尚不明确，缺乏统一、可执行验证的评测基准。
ai_summary.method: 提出 RobotWorld 仿真测试平台，将指令与观测通过机器人接口转化为物理任务执行，涵盖操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶与空中控制共 84 项任务，并设置显式交互预算与可执行的成功判定。通过任务结果与执行轨迹的联合分析，评估多模态智能体的迁移能力与失败模式。
ai_summary.result: 当前智能体能构建图像分割、相机标定、空间估计和动力学计算等复杂感知与控制流程，但这些能力无法稳定组合为成功行为：常出现位姿到达却丢失物体状态、无法纠正无效动作、恢复过晚或误判任务完成等情况；不同模型各有所长，Astra 擅长空间与受限接触类目标，Opus 5.5 擅长连续平衡与定时交互类目标。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次构建覆盖多形态机器人、跨多类物理任务且带交互预算与可执行成功校验的智能体评测基准，并将任务成败与执行轨迹关联以定位具体能力缺口。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型与具身智能体走向物理世界提供了严格的评测标尺，并指明了训练与设计更可靠物理世界智能体的具体方向。

papers.title: Self-correction Optimization for Interleaved Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation. However, generating interleaved image--text content remains challenging, as it requires tightly integrated multimodal understanding and generation capabilities. Although existing MLLMs provide promising solutions, most rely on additional training with augmented data, which is computationally expensive and remains limited in preserving visual subjects, temporal consistency, and physical plausibility. In this work, we propose self-correction optimization (SCO), an effective training-free method for consistent interleaved generation. SCO treats the classifier-free guidance update as a reference and performs minimal self-correction under two complementary constraints, including new-event and state-preserving constraints. Specifically, the new-event constraint promotes temporal consistency across image--text sequences, while the state-preserving constraint maintains the coherence of visual subjects throughout subsequent generation steps. Experiments on challenging interleaved multimodal generation benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in temporal coherence and visual-subject preservation. Furthermore, SCO can be extended to video generation and improves the modeling of physically grounded processes, including robot manipulation and long-horizon handcrafting.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在交错图像-文本生成中难以保持视觉主体、时序一致性和物理合理性，现有方法通常依赖昂贵的额外训练与数据增强。
ai_summary.method: 提出免训练的自校正优化（SCO），将无分类器引导更新作为参考，在“新事件约束”和“状态保持约束”下进行最小自校正，从而提升图像-文本序列的时序一致性和视觉主体连贯性。
ai_summary.result: 在具有挑战性的交错多模态生成基准上显著改善了时序一致性和视觉主体保持，并可扩展到视频生成、机器人操作和长时程手工制作等物理过程建模。
ai_summary.novelty: 将无分类器引导更新作为参考，以双约束最小自校正实现免训练的交错多模态一致生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态生成、视频生成和具身智能中的长程一致性与物理合理性提供了一种低成本优化思路。

papers.title: Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action~(VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning.

ai_summary.problem: 现有面向自动驾驶的VLA模型存在根本性错配：驾驶动作需要精确的3D几何线索，而视觉-语言理解与推理大多在2D语义空间中进行。
ai_summary.method: 提出GeoCoTDrive，一种显式几何思维链框架，采用“先用2D思考、再用专用3D先验驾驶”的范式：先定位对决策关键的2D区域，再从几何基础模型中采样局部3D先验，并将其交错融入自回归上下文以支持轨迹生成；同时引入面向规划的grounding任务和PlanningGrounding数据集。
ai_summary.result: 在多个端到端自动驾驶基准上的实验表明，GeoCoTDrive能持续提升安全关键场景下的规划性能，验证了显式几何思维链对VLA规划的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将面向规划的局部3D几何先验作为显式思维链融入VLA自动驾驶决策，并配套提出planning-relevant grounding任务与数据集。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于弥合2D语义推理与3D几何动作之间的鸿沟，推动更安全、更可解释的VLA与具身自动驾驶系统发展。

papers.title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

ai_summary.problem: 现有通用多模态物理智能体在陌生环境中缺少任务相关信息时，难以通过主动交互去寻找物体、检查属性或测试工具效果，并据此调整行动。
ai_summary.method: 提出 RoboQuest，一个面向目标导向具身探索的基准，包含十项移动操作任务，围绕搜索、基于操作的检查、交互测试三类不确定性；通过统一视觉运动接口评估五种前沿多模态智能体，并微调 π0.5 策略。
ai_summary.result: 最佳智能体仅取得 23% 成功率，微调后的 π0.5 几乎无法成功；若直接提供隐藏信息，智能体大多能完成执行技能，失败更多源于过早停止探索、未修复探索扰动以及试错学习困难。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地评测智能体在物理交互中主动获取任务相关证据、自适应行动并自主决定任务完成时机的具身探索能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为通用物理智能体和世界模型研究提供了关键评测基准与失败诊断，揭示了主动探索和交互适应是当前模型的重要瓶颈。
ai_summary.org: 新加坡科技设计大学 (SUTD)

papers.title: TaoD2C-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Industrial UI Code Generation Beyond Visual Fidelity
papers.abstract: A key challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is moving beyond visual recognition to constraint-aware cross-modal reasoning. This involves combining visual cues with information from other modalities to understand elements' relationships under domain-specific rules. This challenge is acutely evident in industrial design-to-code (D2C), which converts user interface (UI) designs into code and requires MLLMs to connect design images with disorganized layer metadata, infer component and layout implementation requirements, and realize them in code under target-library constraints. However, these capabilities remain insufficiently evaluated in realistic industrial settings. To fill this gap, we present TaoD2C-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs' ability to generate UI code that satisfies implementation requirements in industrial applications. The TaoD2C dataset consists of 2,861 production designs from 17 commercial platforms with 97,652 expert annotations across four categories: Component, Group, Alignment, and Position. These annotations distinguish required constraints from permitted implementation choices. TaoD2C-Bench defines three tasks: end-to-end UI code generation, requirement inference, and requirement realization. Evaluating eight MLLMs reveals substantial gaps in generating UI code that satisfies implementation requirements, alongside distinct performance profiles in inference and realization. We further show that MLLMs' visual reconstruction ability does not necessarily imply an ability to generate code that meets these requirements. We release TaoD2C to support research on industrial UI code generation.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在工业设计到代码（D2C）中需要超越视觉识别，结合设计图像与杂乱图层元数据，在目标库约束下推断并实现组件与布局需求；但现有基准对真实工业场景下的这些能力评估不足。
ai_summary.method: 提出 TaoD2C-Bench，构建包含 2,861 个来自 17 个商业平台的生产设计、97,652 条专家标注的 TaoD2C 数据集，标注覆盖 Component、Group、Alignment、Position 四类，并区分必需约束与允许实现选择。基准定义端到端 UI 代码生成、需求推断、需求实现三个任务，并评测 8 个 MLLM。
ai_summary.result: 评测显示 MLLMs 在生成满足实现要求的 UI 代码上存在显著差距，在需求推断与需求实现上呈现不同表现；视觉重建能力并不必然意味着能生成满足实现要求的代码。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了面向工业 UI 代码生成、关注实现需求而非仅视觉保真度的约束感知基准，并显式区分必需约束与允许实现选择。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在跨模态约束推理、设计到代码和工业 UI 生成方面的评估提供了真实场景测试平台，推动超越视觉保真的能力研究。

papers.title: $Δ$Representation: Geometry Supervised Representation Learning of Phenotypes via Counterfactual Reasoning for Medical VLMs
papers.abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for radiological image interpretation. Medical VLMs encode radiological images into visual representations that capture both anatomical and phenotypic information for diagnosis. Existing approaches improve pathological phenotype representations through semantic-guided representation alignment. However, pathological phenotypes arise as lesion-specific visual changes superimposed on underlying normal anatomy. Such semantic alignment approaches fail to model the phenotype-specific increment relative to the corresponding normal anatomical representation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{$Δ$Representation}, a visual phenotype representation learning framework based on counterfactual reasoning for medical VLMs. It comprises \textbf{BaseAnatomy}, a geometry-supervised representation learning module, and \textbf{$Δ$Phenotype}, a counterfactual incremental representation learning module. BaseAnatomy provides fine-grained geometric supervision through spatial relationships across and within anatomical structures. $Δ$Phenotype computes the representation increment between lesion representations and their corresponding normal anatomical representations, and supervises increments associated with the same phenotype to cluster in the representation space. Experiments on \textit{ReXGroundingCT} and \textit{LIDC-IDRI} demonstrate that $Δ$Representation effectively structures pathological phenotype representations and improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization accuracy in medical VLMs. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/deltarep-CF6D.

ai_summary.problem: 现有医学视觉语言模型通过语义对齐改进病理表型表示，但未能建模病变相对于对应正常解剖结构的表型特异性视觉增量。
ai_summary.method: 提出ΔRepresentation框架，包含BaseAnatomy和ΔPhenotype两个模块：BaseAnatomy利用解剖结构内/间空间关系提供细粒度几何监督；ΔPhenotype通过反事实推理计算病灶表示与对应正常解剖表示之间的增量，并监督相同表型的增量在表示空间中聚类。
ai_summary.result: 在ReXGroundingCT和LIDC-IDRI数据集上，ΔRepresentation能有效结构化病理表型表示，并提升医学VLM的病灶定位和表型刻画准确率。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次以反事实增量表示学习建模病理表型相对于正常解剖的视觉变化，并结合几何监督增强医学VLM的表型表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 为医学视觉语言模型提供了更符合病理形成机制的表示学习思路，有助于提升病灶定位与表型理解的可解释性和准确性。

papers.title: Sparse Planning in Visual World Models via Cost Gradients
papers.abstract: Token-based world models enable fine-grained latent planning, but repeatedly processing large spatial token grids makes action search expensive. We introduce COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens by the gradient norm of the planning cost with respect to each input token. By deriving importance from the downstream control objective, COSTGRAD targets tokens that matter for planning rather than merely for prediction. On AdaLN-conditioned predictors at $50\%$ sparsity, COSTGRAD matches or exceeds full-token planning on three of four continuous-control benchmarks, while giving a measured $2.6\times$ wall-clock speedup per environment planning step. Combining token sparsity with reduced CEM search increases this to a $\sim 5\times$ total speedup while still exceeding the full-token baseline. We also identify an architecture-dependent failure mode: in a matched AdaLN-vs-concat comparison, concat maintains comparable full-token performance but pure COSTGRAD loses its advantage over random selection. This difference tracks action-pathway drift: gradient-selected removal produces less drift than random removal on AdaLN, but more on concat. These results highlight selector-architecture compatibility as a design axis for sparse world-model planning. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/

ai_summary.problem: 基于 token 的世界模型虽然能做细粒度潜在规划，但反复处理大规模空间 token 网格导致动作搜索开销巨大，需要在不重训练的前提下降低规划成本。
ai_summary.method: 提出 COSTGRAD：一种无需训练、目标条件化的空间 token 选择器，用规划代价对每个输入 token 的梯度范数来衡量 token 重要性，从而筛出对下游控制目标（而非仅对预测）关键的 token，并可与缩减的 CEM 搜索结合使用。
ai_summary.result: 在 AdaLN 条件预测器上以 50% 稀疏度即可在四个连续控制基准中的三个追平或超过全 token 规划，单步规划实测加速 2.6 倍，叠加 CEM 搜索缩减后总加速约 5 倍仍优于全 token 基线；但该优势依赖架构，在 concat 条件化下会退化到随机选择水平，原因与动作通路漂移有关。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用规划代价的梯度（而非预测误差或注意力）来无训练地筛选世界模型中的空间 token，并揭示选择器与条件化架构的兼容性是稀疏规划的关键设计维度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型/具身智能中高效长时程规划提供了即插即用的加速方案，并提示稀疏化方法需与模型架构协同设计。

papers.title: Geometry-Supervised Visual Representation Learning for Multi-Phenotype Lesion Interpretation in Medical VLMs
papers.abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation. However, these models still struggle to interpret multi-phenotype lesions whose diagnosis requires the joint assessment of multiple pathological phenotypes. Existing vision-language alignment methods produce visual representations that fail to preserve anatomical hierarchies and relationships among phenotypic subclasses. This stems from their reliance on semantic supervision, which lacks geometric constraints to preserve these relationships in the visual embedding space. Moreover, the sparsity of lesion-related anatomical and phenotypic representations makes it difficult for medical VLMs to capture important diagnostic evidence. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PureVision}, a geometry-supervised visual representation learning framework for multi-phenotype lesion interpretation in medical VLMs. It combines a geometry-supervised representation learning module, \textbf{PureEyes}, and an anatomy-guided evidence aggregation module, \textbf{PureNeurons}. PureEyes provides geometric supervision through ideal spatial distributions that encode anatomical hierarchies and phenotypic subclass relationships. PureNeurons projects visual representations into the learned latent space, using their positions to selectively aggregate lesion-specific anatomical and phenotypic evidence. Experiments on \textit{LIDC-IDRI}, \textit{CBIS-DDSM}, and \textit{3DReasonKnee} demonstrate that PureVision improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization in visual question answering and radiology report generation. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/purevision-06C2.

ai_summary.problem: 医学视觉语言模型在解读多表型病灶时，难以联合评估多种病理表型，现有视觉-语言对齐方法缺乏几何约束，无法在视觉嵌入空间中保留解剖层级和表型子类关系。
ai_summary.method: 提出PureVision框架，包含几何监督表示学习模块PureEyes和解剖引导证据聚合模块PureNeurons。PureEyes通过编码解剖层级与表型子类关系的理想空间分布提供几何监督，PureNeurons将视觉表示投影到学习到的潜在空间，并依据其位置选择性聚合病灶相关的解剖与表型证据。
ai_summary.result: 在LIDC-IDRI、CBIS-DDSM和3DReasonKnee数据集上的实验表明，PureVision在视觉问答和放射报告生成中提升了病灶定位与表型刻画能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用理想空间分布为视觉表示提供几何监督，以保留医学解剖层级和表型子类关系，并结合解剖引导的证据聚合增强多表型病灶解读。
ai_summary.relevance: 为医学视觉语言模型提供了更具几何与解剖结构约束的视觉表示学习思路，有助于提升多表型病灶诊断相关任务的可靠性和可解释性。

papers.title: Benchmarking Behavioral Steerability in Behavior Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) are emerging as a paradigm for translating human intentions into executable humanoid behaviors. As these models evolve beyond behavior generation toward general-purpose behavioral systems, a fundamental question arises: can they be reliably steered according to user intentions? In this paper, we introduce the concept of behavioral steerability, defined as the ability of BFMs to faithfully generate behaviors that satisfy user-specified intentions. To study this capability, we present RoboSteer, the first benchmark for behavioral steerability in BFMs. RoboSteer organizes behavioral steerability into a three-level hierarchy-Conditional Steering, Constraint Steering, and Compositional Steering-and establishes a unified evaluation framework supported by a large-scale multimodal motion corpus. Using RoboSteer, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of behavioral steerability across 9 existing BFMs. We view behavioral steerability as more than a capability for controlling motion: it concerns how embodied systems translate human intentions into purposeful actions. We hope RoboSteer will advance research on intention realization as a foundation for general-purpose embodied intelligence.

ai_summary.problem: 行为基础模型（BFMs）能否根据用户意图被可靠地引导，即实现行为可引导性，仍缺乏系统研究。
ai_summary.method: 提出“行为可引导性”概念，并构建首个BFM行为可引导性基准RoboSteer；该基准分为条件引导、约束引导和组合引导三个层级，提供统一评估框架和大规模多模态运动语料。
ai_summary.result: 基于RoboSteer对9个现有BFM进行了首个大规模实证研究，为评估和提升BFM按用户意图生成行为的能力提供了基准与实验依据。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出行为可引导性概念，并建立分层、多模态、可统一评估的RoboSteer基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动具身智能从单纯运动生成走向人类意图的可靠实现，为通用具身智能提供重要评估基础。
ai_summary.org: 未提供作者所属机构信息

papers.title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Understand Instructions? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study on Language Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models are designed to generalise across environments and task descriptions, raising the question of whether their action generation actually depends on the language instruction, or whether they largely rely on visual cues and superficial correlations. Robustness to variance in the visual and linguistic observation space is critical for real-world deployment, yet VLAs lack explicit grounding modules and instead rely on the intrinsic language grounding capabilities of their Vision-Language model backbones. For this reason, we conduct a controlled mechanistic interpretability study on the language grounding capabilities of two state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7, by applying activation and attribution patching to the residual stream of the action generation modules. We systematically corrupt the task instruction of input samples of the LIBERO benchmark following five strategies: synonym replacement, semantic scaling, directional corruption, random object substitution, and empty string. Our experiments find that both models are comparatively insensitive to abstract rephrasing and to referencing non-existent objects, but react strongly to empty task descriptions and, especially, to directional language. During action generation, this sensitivity is concentrated in different loci for each model: mainly in the early, periodic cross-attention layers for GR00T N1.7, versus distributed across the earliest and selected later layers for $π_{0.5}$. For GR00T N1.7, directional perturbations drive some of the largest causal effects while leaving the internal representational geometry comparatively unchanged, a dissociation we do not observe clearly for $π_{0.5}$. Finally, the reliability of attribution patching is model-dependent: it closely tracks activation patching for GR00T N1.7 but not for $π_{0.5}$.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的动作生成究竟是否真正依赖语言指令，还是主要依靠视觉线索与表面相关性？论文要检验VLA模型内在的语言接地能力及其对语言扰动（尤其是方向性语言）的鲁棒性。
ai_summary.method: 对两个SOTA VLA模型 π_{0.5} 与 GR00T N1.7 在 LIBERO 基准上做受控的机制可解释性研究：在动作生成模块的残差流上应用激活修补（activation patching）与归因修补（attribution patching），并按同义词替换、语义缩放、方向性破坏、随机物体替换、空字符串五种策略系统性地破坏任务指令。
ai_summary.result: 两个模型对抽象改写和引用不存在物体相对不敏感，但对空指令、尤其是方向性语言反应强烈；敏感位置因模型而异——GR00T N1.7 集中于早期周期性交叉注意力层，π_{0.5} 则分散于最早层和部分后层；GR00T N1.7 中方向扰动产生最大因果效应却几乎不改变内部表征几何，而 π_{0.5} 未见此分离；归因修补对 GR00T N1.7 可靠但对 π_{0.5} 不可靠。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用激活/归因修补等机制可解释性手段，对主流VLA模型的语言接地进行细粒度因果定位与跨模型对比，并揭示因果效应与表征几何可分离的现象。
ai_summary.relevance: 为评估和提升VLA/具身智能体的语言指令理解与鲁棒性提供了机制层面的诊断工具与证据，提示不同架构需要不同的可解释性方法。

papers.title: MemoCare: An Interactive Multimodal Mobile System for Automated Cognitive Screening
papers.abstract: MemoCare is an interactive mobile system for automated multimodal cognitive screening. A React Native application combines spoken responses, temporal and spatial orientation, touchscreen actions, and visuoconstruction in complete English and Vietnamese workflows. Speech is transcribed by Google Speech-to-Text and scored locally with deterministic task-specific natural language processing rules; GPS coordinates are resolved by the MemoCare spatial module before answer matching; touch tasks are scored from interaction events; and the drawing task uses a three-model convolutional neural network consensus with separate visual interpretation. Software tests pass 151/151 predefined cases across speech/language, spatial-answer, and touch-interaction scoring, while spatial regression passes 48/48 four-country coordinate-resolution cases. For the drawing module, validation-selected ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 achieved 91.33% mean balanced accuracy and 78.87% exact three-criterion accuracy on a locked 71-image test set. Four clinician co-authors additionally inspected the end-to-end workflow, yielding a pooled median rating of 4/5 across eight criteria, with item-level medians ranging from 3 to 4.5. At MMM, attendees can directly try a shortened multimodal screening workflow and inspect automatic item-level and total scoring.

ai_summary.problem: 该论文旨在解决如何通过移动端自动化、多模态方式完成认知筛查，减少人工施测负担，并支持英语和越南语完整流程。
ai_summary.method: 作者开发了基于 React Native 的 MemoCare 应用，整合语音回答、时空定向、触屏操作和视空间构建任务；语音经 Google Speech-to-Text 转写后用本地确定性 NLP 规则评分，GPS 由空间模块解析，触摸任务按交互事件评分，绘图任务采用三个 CNN 共识模型并单独进行视觉解释。
ai_summary.result: 软件测试通过 151/151 个预设用例，空间回归通过 48/48 个四国坐标解析用例；绘图模块中经验证选择的 ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 在 71 张锁定测试集上达到 91.33% 平均平衡准确率和 78.87% 三标准完全准确率；四名临床医生合著者评估端到端工作流，八项标准汇总中位评分为 4/5。
ai_summary.novelty: 将多模态认知筛查任务、自动评分和移动端交互工作流整合为一个可现场试用的完整系统。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了多模态 AI 在移动医疗与认知筛查中的应用潜力，但并非大模型、世界模型或具身智能方向的核心突破。
